dimensions.name: recoverability
dimensions.notes: A machine-readable recovery checkpoint contract exists in the isolated side-track.

dimensions.name: authority-boundedness
dimensions.notes: Capability expansion requires a new attributable authorization event.

dimensions.name: context-handoff
dimensions.notes: Handoff is informational and does not transfer execution authority.

dimensions.name: stale-state-detection
dimensions.notes: Moved or divergent main state invalidates continuation assumptions.

dimensions.name: parallel-isolation
dimensions.notes: The side-track remains additive and does not touch active protocol/workflow paths.

dimensions.name: duplicate-realization-control
dimensions.notes: Main-line semantic overlap can be assessed without automatic replacement.

dimensions.name: inactivity-resilience
dimensions.notes: Inactivity creates neither consent nor automatic resume authority.

dimensions.name: human-sustainability
dimensions.notes: Non-diagnostic interaction-load controls exist, but no canonical project integration has occurred.

dimensions.name: validation-availability
dimensions.notes: Local-only validation exists and is intentionally not connected to CI.

notes: This matrix describes evidence dimensions separately instead of producing a universal project-health score.
Established in the side-track does not mean integrated into canonical main.
